race.comment: Hard to go past the progressive CUSTOM (9) who was a dominant winner in BM74 grade at Caulfield last time out, settling back off a fast tempo and charging away to score by three lengths. Stays right down in the weights here, perhaps the only niggle is if she's ridden cold again here off what looks a much slower tempo. Still expect her to be too good for them though. STYLISH (3) is racing very well, off a let up for this. She got home strongly for second in the Leilani Final to Duchess Zou last start, back to 1200m is the issue for her. Conversely, staying at 1200m might be the niggle for BETWITCHERY (4) who ran a good race first up at Flemington behind PIASTRI (5) who bounced back to form. BETWITCHERY will be fitter and maps to roll across and lead which helps. GREAT MAXIMUS (1) is consistent and in the mix again.
